title: working-model spec
description: A small discrete-time model with visual parts, captions and claims that are checked by simulation.

id.description: Short kebab-case id.

summary.description: One or two sentences under the title. May use {param} holes.

sources.description: Where the key facts come from.

timeUnit.description: Unit of model time shown in the page, such as "s", "day", "RTT", "year".

dt.description: Length of one tick in model time.

seed.description: Seed for rand() and random events (default 1).

id.description: Name used in expressions.

choices.description: Names for each step from min to max; the page shows buttons instead of a slider.

format.description: How the value is shown, such as "%" for 0.4 as 40%, ".2", "," or "int".

state.description: Starting values: numbers, true/false, lists, or expression strings (use quotes inside for text, such as "'closed'").

derived.description: Named expressions recomputed from state at every moment.

at.description: One time, a list of times, or an expression.

every.description: Period of a repeating event. A number, or an expression over params.

rate.description: Random arrivals per unit of time (Poisson, seeded). A number, or an expression over params.

from.description: First time for every/rate (default 0). A number, or an expression over params.

until.description: Last time for every/rate (default: end of run). A number, or an expression over params.

count.description: How many fire at each occurrence (a burst). Default 1. A number, or an expression over params.

init.description: Runs once at t = 0 after state is set. Rule code: one string, or an array of lines.

tick.description: Runs every tick, before that tick's events. Rule code: one string, or an array of lines.

additionalProperties.description: Handler. Rule code: one string, or an array of lines.

parts.description: Visual parts bound to the model.

cites.description: Claim ids this caption relies on.

speed.description: Model time per second of playback (default: duration / 15).

allowNumbers.description: Numbers allowed as literals in text.

ignore.description: Surviving mutants that are truly harmless, each with the reason. They are left out of the mutation score.

mutant.description: The mutant as check --mutate prints it: location and change, such as "rules.tick:1:8 t > 12 → t >= 12".

reason.description: Why no claim can or should notice this change.

reality.description: Optional Reality Bridge settings: the default mapping and observed trace for check --trace, and the assumptions and sources the comparison rests on. Leaving it out changes nothing.

mapping.description: Path to trace-map.json, relative to this spec and inside its folder.

observedTrace.description: Path to a normalized trace (made by trace import), relative to this spec and inside its folder.

assumptions.description: What the comparison assumes, written separately from the claims.

id.description: Assumption id.

sourceRefs.description: Documents behind the model. A URL is documentation text only; nothing is fetched.

fuzz.description: Optional settings for the fuzz command: which scheduled events it may move, repeat or drop. Leaving it out changes nothing.

events.description: Map from an event name to how fuzz may perturb it.

fuzzable.description: Must be true for fuzz to touch this event.

shift.description: Largest shift of the event time, in model time units, either way.

id.description: Unique part id, used by links.

label.description: Small caption drawn with the part.

visible.description: Expression: draw the part only while this is true.

highlight.description: Expression: ring the part in the accent colour while true.

tone.description: A colour token (ink, muted, accent, ok, bad, warn, soft, info), a #rrggbb colour, or an expression that returns one.

note.description: Free text for authors; not shown.
